_meta.description: Model capability classification rules. Both Python and TypeScript consume this file for parity.
_meta.note: All prefix values are regex patterns anchored at start (^), matched against the model id AFTER its gateway vendor prefix is stripped (openai/gpt-5.6-luna -> gpt-5.6-luna). Use ^o\d to match o1/o2/o3/o4... but NOT opus/omni/orca.
